question: Rs. 15,000 is lent for one year at the rate of 20% per annum, the interest being compounded annually. If the compounding of the interest is done half-yearly, then how much more interest will be obtained at the end of the one-year period on the same initial sum?
solution:
**Given:-**

Principal (P)= Rs. 15000,

R = 20%

**Formula used:-**

The compound interest on a sum of Rs. P at R% per annum in one year, 

When compounded annually, CI = P[(1 + R/100) – 1] = PR/100

When compounded half-yearly, CI = P[(1 + R/200)² – 1]
